# Spellblade: the balance ledger (generated by `tools/src/ledger/write.ts spellblade`; do not edit by hand)

Hand prices from `tools/src/ledger/spellblade.ts`, against the budgets of docs/14_CARD_COSTING.md (1 Mana common = 10, then +9 a Mana; uncommon x1.12, rare x1.25, basic x0.8; an Aura over four turns at 1.5x (uncommon) or 2x (rare) its cost's budget; Consume +25%). The new rates are in the guide's §15. These are hypotheses for hand balance, not measured win rates.

89 cards; 88 within ±15% of budget, the rest explained in the last column.
